nodes.title: Type single and multi props as one union
nodes.why: The multiple flag decides whether value is a string or an array, so the compiler rejects onChange handlers of the wrong shape.
nodes.alternative: Accept value: string | string[] and check Array.isArray at runtime.
nodes.tradeoff: A union is a little more typing for the author and removes a whole class of caller bugs.

nodes.title: Share state through one context
nodes.why: Trigger, Options and Option can sit anywhere under the root and still read the same open state and selection.
nodes.alternative: Clone the children with extra props through React.Children.
nodes.tradeoff: Context survives wrapper elements and custom layouts; cloning breaks as soon as a part is not a direct child.

nodes.title: Fail loudly when a part is used outside the root
nodes.why: A clear error beats a silent no-op when someone renders Select.Option on its own.
nodes.alternative: Return a default context that does nothing.
nodes.tradeoff: Defaults hide mistakes; an error names the broken part.

nodes.title: Derive the selection from the controlled value

anchor.snippet: const selected = props.multiple ? props.value : props.value === null ? [] : [props.value];

nodes.why: The parent owns the value; normalizing both modes to an array keeps every part on one code path.
nodes.alternative: Copy the value into internal state.
nodes.tradeoff: Internal copies drift from the parent; deriving keeps a single source of truth.

nodes.title: Toggle in multi mode, replace and close in single mode
nodes.why: Multi-select users add and remove several values in one visit, while a single choice should close the list.
nodes.tradeoff: Closing in multi mode forces a reopen for every extra value.

nodes.title: Let options register their labels with the root
nodes.why: The trigger needs labels for values chosen before the list was ever opened, such as the initial Nuts.
nodes.alternative: Walk the children tree to find Option elements.
nodes.tradeoff: Registration works through wrappers and maps; a layout effect avoids painting the raw value first.

nodes.title: Keep the listbox mounted and toggle hidden
nodes.why: Options stay mounted so they can register, and aria-controls always points at a real element.
nodes.alternative: Render the listbox only while open.
nodes.tradeoff: Unmounting loses the labels until the first open; hidden keeps both behavior and ARIA consistent.

nodes.title: Block disabled options at the click
nodes.why: A disabled option stays visible and announced through aria-disabled but cannot change the value.
nodes.alternative: Leave disabled options out of the list.
nodes.tradeoff: Hiding them removes context the user may need; blocking keeps it visible.

nodes.title: Close on Escape from anywhere inside
nodes.why: Listening on the root catches Escape whether focus is on the trigger or inside the list.
nodes.alternative: Attach a keydown listener to document.
nodes.tradeoff: A root handler scopes the shortcut to this select and needs no cleanup.
